verification: published_large_file_hashes: model.safetensors and voice_*.safetensors SHA-256/bytes from the official Hugging Face tree API (LFS oid) at the pinned revision, re-verified from a local authenticated download (the repository is gated: auto).

small_file_hashes: tokenizer.json/tokenizer.model hashed from raw bytes fetched at the pinned revision (tokenizer.json is byte-identical to the without-voice-cloning english_2026-09 tokenizer the recipe YAML references; same git blob oid).

flat_layout: the HF repository stores this recipe under languages/english_2026-09_2/ with subdirectories, which this registry cannot express; evaluate.py and prepare_checkpoint.py build a flat checkpoint directory (config.json, model.safetensors, tokenizer.json, tokenizer.model, voice_alba|vera|michael.safetensors) by downloading the pinned subpaths and writing the authored config files. The harness --download shortcut is NOT used for this pack.

authored_config: config.json is generated by evaluate.py (embedded constant, sha256 pinned in files below); it mirrors the recipe YAML pocket_tts/config/english_2026-09_2.yaml from github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts commit ec569b2dd3fec4a601b391aace185791e92b3785 (blob 594c905b41356ba4b65098d02fd610268ee7e34d) plus the pinned generation defaults of pocket-tts 3.3.0. The YAML itself is also embedded in evaluate.py and materialized with local weights/tokenizer paths for TTSModel.load_model.

scope: Checkpoint identity and architecture metadata; not a claim of successful accelerator execution or support at every precision. Other languages and the 24-layer variants in the repository are NOT part of this manifest.
